nodes.label: Courtyard
nodes.desc: The central grounds of Candlekeep bustle with robed scholars and curious monks.

npcs.name: Imoen
npcs.dialogue: I'm going with you! You can't stop me, ya know!

npcs.name: Reevor
npcs.dialogue: Clear those rats out of the storehouse!

events.text: You recall your lessons under Gorion's watchful eye.

nodes.label: Bunkhouse
nodes.desc: Simple quarters where the acolytes and workers sleep.

events.text: An assassin lurks in the shadows!

nodes.label: Inner Library
nodes.desc: Towering bookshelves and silent scholars studying ancient tomes.

npcs.name: Karan
npcs.dialogue: You are troubled, my child. Speak freely.

nodes.label: Storehouse
nodes.desc: Candlekeep’s supplies are stored here, and it's been overrun with vermin.

events.text: Reevor asks you to kill the rats inside.
